A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the VAA approach can be applied to prove any property expressible in temporal logic over any reactive system, and it does so by a two-step process of abstraction, followed by model checking, where each of the two steps is guaranteed to preserve the desired properties, and the whole process is guaranteed to terminate.
